description: Rijnbuurt-Oost (Plan Zuid, BAG 1934), Hoendiepstraat 5-35 (odd side): a 6.1 m brick front, every house alike: a two-storey canted brick erker against the left party wall (white-framed three-light glazing over brick stallrisers on storeys 1-2) on a white console over a wide ground window, a narrow window axis on the right over the paired house doors, and the top storey painted white with four small two-light windows, under a shallow flat-roof overhang with a white fascia

overhang.note: the shallow overhang over the white attic storey

door-right.note: the paired house doors under the narrow axis

match.note: the white attic storey and the erker against the party wall tell it from the ribbon and pair types; the photo decides (auto-place --photo-decides)
